name: com.pyunto/diary
title: Pyunto Diary
description: Read, search and write your encrypted Pyunto diary from Claude. Decrypts only on your own machine.

environmentVariables.name: PYUNTO_AGENT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Display name of this assistant's own Pyunto account, shown to the people in the diary

environmentVariables.name: PYUNTO_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: sign in as a registered Pyunto account instead of creating the assistant's own

environmentVariables.name: PYUNTO_AGENT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the account's identity key, space keys and decrypted attachments are kept
